items.title: Mastercard opens Singapore innovation centre of excellence
items.snippet: Mastercard has opened an innovation centre of excellence in Singapore that will eventually house 250 specialists working in areas such as AI, digital commerce and cybersecurity.

items.title: Visa and Anchorage Digital bring Western Union stablecoin to settlement network
items.snippet: Visa is working with Anchorage Digital to support select stablecoins as native settlement assets on the payment giant's network, starting with Western Union's USDPT.
